scope: Single-seed source-loss weight 1 to 0 contrast with unchanged MAE, architecture, initialization, data and schedule. The normalized objective changes subsequent gradients and the optimization trajectory. This identifies the complete intervention for this run, not a unique biological source mechanism; production CUDA remains nondeterministic as in the parent. Food-group intervals condition on selected checkpoints, not seed-population, label-validity or transfer uncertainty. Screening cannot accept a final model.
